submission.justification:
Absorber-F3 at 4mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.231% at 100 GeV among all 15 configurations tested (3 materials × 5 thicknesses from 2-10mm). This represents a 16% performance improvement over the next-best option (Absorber-F2 at 6mm: 3.847%) and a 55% improvement over Absorber-F1's optimum (4mm: 5.013%).

The 4mm thickness falls well within the required 2-10mm range and shows robust performance with a flat optimum (6mm yields nearly identical 3.258% resolution). This configuration optimally balances sampling frequency with shower development to achieve superior energy resolution.

CRITICAL CAVEAT: The residual dose rate constraint (≤20 µSv/h at 1m after one week cooldown) could not be verified from available documentation or simulation tools. This recommendation assumes all candidate materials satisfy this hard safety requirement, as they are all listed as viable options without activation warnings in project documents. Verification of Absorber-F3's residual dose rate through activation simulation is MANDATORY before implementation. If F3 fails the dose constraint, the recommended fallback is Absorber-F2 at 6mm thickness.
